name: securacv-backoffice
description: The self-hosted business backend for Errer Labs / SecuraCV — orders, support, mail, inventory, warranty, books, status — one SQLite file, zero dependencies.

scripts.demo: BACKOFFICE_DATA_DIR=./data-demo node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning bin/backoffice.mjs demo --reset && BACKOFFICE_DATA_DIR=./data-demo node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning bin/backoffice.mjs serve
scripts.dev: BACKOFFICE_DATA_DIR=./data-demo node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning bin/backoffice.mjs demo --if-empty && BACKOFFICE_DATA_DIR=./data-demo node --watch --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning bin/backoffice.mjs serve
